one_month_reasoning: Arista's Q3 2026 report date has not been announced (no 8-K or date release as of Sep 30). Arista has reported on Tuesdays (Nov 4 2025, May 5 and Aug 4 2026), so Tue Nov 3 is the likely date. Nov 2, which I used in round 1, is a Monday. Either date falls after the Oct 30 window, so no company print lands inside it. The in-window industry read-throughs are two-sided: late-October hyperscaler Q3 prints (Microsoft is 26% and Meta 16% of Arista revenue) with 2027 capex commentary, and Celestica's Q3 (late Oct). Celestica's own Q2 release (source 16) already told investors that 2027 growth will accelerate beyond 2026's 65%, so a reaffirmation is mostly priced in. Realized vol over the last 20/40 trading days is ~40-45%, below the 54% one-year figure. I therefore use a lognormal centred just above spot (median ~$204.3) with ~14.5% monthly sigma, a little tighter than the 15.4% I used in round 1.

fair_value.method: The P/E leg is NTM EPS at Sep-2027 of ~$6.02 (0.25 x FY27 consensus $5.20 + 0.75 x FY28E $6.24) x 33x = ~$199, weight 0.6. The FCF-yield leg is FY28E FCF ~$7.8B at 2.8% = ~$279B EV, plus ~$19.5B projected Sep-2027 net cash, over 1.276B shares = ~$234, weight 0.4. The blend is ~$213.

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: NTM (Q4'27-Q3'28) non-GAAP EPS at Sep-2027 ~$6.02 = 0.25 x FY27 $5.20 + 0.75 x FY28E $6.24 (+20%); x 33x forward multiple

inputs_detail.derivation: My own round-1 industry build gave ~$5.05. It haircut Arista for relative share loss (DC +37.6% vs market +64.5%, IDC). Dell'Oro says the AI back-end gap is largely deferred-revenue timing ($6.87B deferred, +$1.5B in H1), so I drop most of that haircut and use consensus.

Broadcom sees AI semis roughly doubling again, DC capex is heading to ~$1.3-1.5T in 2027-28, and Celestica (a white-box competitor and supply-chain bellwether) says in its own release that 2027 growth accelerates beyond 65%. I haircut to ~20% EPS growth for a decelerating base and share pressure from Nvidia and Cisco.

Spot is ~41x NTM (~$4.93) and 39x FY27. Growth decelerates from ~40% to ~20-25% by Sep 2027, so the multiple compresses. I use 33x, one turn above round 1's 32x, because the Dell'Oro deferred-revenue qualification makes the share data less bearish. That is still below the ~34x five-year average, because Nvidia leads branded DC share.

methods.name: FCF yield
methods.inputs: FY2028E FCF ~$7.8B / 2.8% = ~$279B EV; + ~$19.5B projected Sep-2027 net cash; / 1.276B diluted shares

inputs_detail.input: Cash + marketable securities at 6/30/26, no debt

inputs_detail.derivation: $13.34B plus ~5 quarters of ~$1.3-1.5B normalised FCF, less modest buyback (~$818M authorisation left, none used in H1 2026). Round 1 added only today's $13.3B at a Sep-2027 horizon, which undercounted by ~$4.5/share.

FY28E net income ~$8.0B ($6.24 x 1.276B) at ~95-100% conversion (capex tiny, H1 capex $84M). Trimmed for inventory and purchase-commitment builds, which held H1 OCF ex-deferred revenue to ~22% of revenue.

Equivalent to ~33-35x earnings for a net-cash franchise with 60%+ gross margin. Memory-driven component inflation (Dell'Oro campus ASP +19%) has so far been passed through; management targets margin-neutral into 2027.

bear.story: Signs of 2028 AI capex digestion appear by mid-2027, or Arista's share loss to Nvidia Spectrum-X, Cisco and Celestica white boxes proves structural rather than deferred-revenue timing. 2027 growth slows to ~15%, memory costs squeeze gross margin, and the multiple de-rates to ~23x on ~$5.8B NTM EPS.

base.story: The industry keeps growing fast (hyperscaler capex toward ~$1T+ in 2027, 1.6T ramps, Celestica guiding acceleration). Arista grows ~28% in 2027, in line with the $16.29B consensus, as deferred AI revenue converts. NTM EPS is ~$6.0 at ~33-35x, plus ~$15/share cash.

bull.story: The supply-constrained market (Dell'Oro: 1-2 years) favours the vendor with secured supply. Scale-across and 1.6T win big at Microsoft, Meta and OpenAI-class customers, deferred revenue releases, and 2027 growth reaches 35%+. CY28 EPS ~$7.3 at ~40x.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$140 the stock trades near 27x FY27 consensus EPS ($5.20), well under the ~34x five-year average forward multiple. That price implies the market sees either a 2028 hyperscaler capex cut or a structural share loss at Microsoft or Meta (42% of revenue combined) to Nvidia or white-box, visible as deferred revenue unwinding rather than converting. Ordinary volatility rarely takes it there without such news. It is also just below the May 2026 post-Q1 lows of $136-142.

reasoning: Round 2 corrections. (1) I replaced the discredited tickergate $5.28 with current consensus (Yahoo, verified: FY26 $4.11 and FY27 $5.20 from 29 analysts, FY27 revenue $16.29B). (2) I re-read Dell'Oro's 2Q26 release. Arista ranked 3rd in AI back-end 'but would have been more closely tied if deferred AI revenue were included', and the market stays supply-constrained for 1-2 years. So I weight the share-loss narrative less and use consensus EPS instead of my haircut ~$5.05. IDC's branded-vendor data still show Nvidia ahead, so the bear case stays. (3) I verified the Celestica 2027 claim in its own Q2 release (8-K): revenue growth in 2027 accelerates beyond 65%, and EPS grows faster. That confirms strong industry demand, and also that a direct white-box competitor is growing faster than Arista. (4) I projected horizon net cash (~$19.5B, ~$15/share) instead of adding today's $13.3B. (5) I also fixed a method inconsistency: round 1 applied the multiple to full FY28 EPS, and I now use true NTM at Sep-2027 (~$6.02). Net effect: the P/E leg moves $200 to $199, the FCF leg $228 to $234, and the blend $211 to $213. I shifted scenario weights slightly toward base (bear 25% to 23%, base price $215 to $218), giving a mean of ~$218. The 12-month ladder rises ~1 point through the middle, and I keep round 1's fat tails because the stock is a levered bet on AI capex with 54% realized vol. The 1-month ladder is tightened to ~14.5% sigma because recent realized vol is 40-45% and there is no Arista print in the window. Analyst targets ($231-242 mean) are evidence only; I sit below them because I expect multiple compression from ~41x NTM.
